zones.title: Triggers + session gate
zones.body: 06:00 prep and every 5 min 08:00-09:55 ET. Get today's calendar; on a non-trading day the gate stops the run. phase = prep / scan / freeze (>= OPEN-5m).

zones.title: Discovery + rank
zones.body: Union Alpaca movers (gap%) and most-actives (liquidity), enrich with one snapshots batch. Frozen v0: gate price>=$5 and dollar_vol>=$5M, rank by abs(gap%), cap 10 + SPY/QQQ benchmarks. Places no orders.

zones.title: Persist + freeze
zones.body: Each scan preserves a candidate snapshot and upserts the calendar. session_id = uuid_generate_v5, matching the recorder's bars. The manifest freezes once at OPEN-5m, never overwritten.
